paragraphs: The Company's legal name is Flutter Entertainment plc. The Company was originally incorporated and registered in Ireland as a private limited company on April 8, 1958, under the name Corcoran's Management Limited with the registration number 16956. The Company, which would later operate under the name Paddy Power plc, was then formed in 1988 through the merger of three independent bookmakers, including Corcoran's Management Limited. The Company re-registered as a public limited company on November 15, 2000, and, in December 2000, it listed on the Irish Stock Exchange and the London Stock Exchange ("LSE"). The Company merged with Betfair Group plc on February 2, 2016, and changed its name to Paddy Power Betfair plc. The Company then changed its name to Flutter Entertainment plc on May 28, 2019. On January 29, 2024, the Company completed its registration process with the United States Securities and Exchange Commission ("SEC"), and listed on the New York Stock Exchange ("NYSE") for public trading. Since listing on the NYSE, the Company has maintained its status on the LSE and delisted from the Irish Stock Exchange. On May 31, 2024, the Company moved its primary listing to the NYSE following the approval of shareholders at the Company's Annual General Meeting held on May 1, 2024.

The Company's global operational headquarters is One Madison Avenue, New York, New York 10010, United States. The Company's registered office is: Belfield Office Park, Beech Hill Road, Clonskeagh, Dublin 4, D04 V972, Ireland. The Company's website is www.flutter.com. The information on, or accessible from, our website is not part of, nor incorporated by reference into, this Annual Report. We make available free of charge, on or through the "Investors" section of our website, our Annual Report on Form 10-K, Quarterly Reports on Form 10-Q, Current Reports on Form 8-K and amendments to those reports, if any, or other filings filed or furnished pursuant to Section 13(a) or 15(d) of the Exchange Act as soon as reasonably practicable after electronically filing or furnishing these reports with the SEC. The SEC maintains a website at http://www.sec.gov that contains our Annual Report on Form 10-K, Quarterly Reports on Form 10-Q, Current Reports on Form 8-K and amendments to those reports, if any, or other filings filed or furnished pursuant to Section 13(a) or 15(d) of the Exchange Act.

We use our website (www.flutter.com) and at times our corporate X account (@FlutterEnt) and LinkedIn (https://www.linkedin.com/company/flutter-entertainment/) as well as other social media channels to distribute company information. Accordingly, investors should monitor these channels, in addition to following our press releases, SEC filings and public conference calls and webcasts. The contents of our website and social media channels are not, however, a part of this Annual Report on Form 10-K.

Flutter is the world's leading online sports betting and iGaming operator based on revenue. Our ambition is to change our industry for the better and deliver long-term growth while also achieving a positive, sustainable future for all our stakeholders. We are well-placed to do so through the global competitive advantages of the Flutter Edge, which provides our brands with access to group-wide benefits to stay ahead of the competition, while maintaining a clear vision for sustainability through our Positive Impact Plan.

The Group consists of a diverse portfolio of leading recreational brands and products with a broad international reach. We operate some of the world's most distinctive online sports betting and iGaming brands which offer our principal product categories of sportsbook, iGaming and other products (exchange betting, pari-mutuel wagering, daily fantasy sports ("DFS") and prediction markets in the U.S.).

These products are offered by FanDuel (sportsbook, iGaming and other products), Sky Betting & Gaming (sportsbook and iGaming products), Sportsbet (sportsbook products), PokerStars (iGaming products), Paddy Power (sportsbook and iGaming products), Sisal1 (sportsbook and iGaming products), Snai (sportsbook, iGaming products and other products), tombola (iGaming products), Betfair (sportsbook, iGaming and other products), TVG (other products), Adjarabet (iGaming products), MaxBet (sportsbook and iGaming products) and Betnacional (sportsbook and iGaming products).
During fiscal 2025, we have completed the following acquisitions of:
1 Sisal's iGaming products include retail and online lottery products. See "—Our Products—iGaming" below for additional information.

•a 5% redeemable non-controlling interest in FanDuel Group Parent LLC ("FanDuel") held by Boyd Interactive Holdings L.L.C. ("Boyd") for a consideration of $1,553 million. The acquisition brings the Group's holding in FanDuel to 100% (subject to the Fox Option).

•a 56% interest in NSX Group ("NSX"), a leading Brazilian operator of the Betnacional brand for a total consideration of BRL 3,799 million ($674 million), with a redemption mechanism in the form of call and put options which allows us to acquire the remaining interest in year five and year ten following the completion date.

•100% of the outstanding shares of Pluto (Italia) S.p.A, the holding company that owns Snaitech S.p.A ("Snai"), one of Italy's leading omni-channel operators in the sports betting and iGaming market, for consideration of approximately $2.6 billion (€2.3 billion).

In December 2025, we launched FanDuel Predicts in partnership with CME Group ("CME") in five states, beginning a phased national rollout through early 2026 and providing eligible customers with a mobile and web platform to trade prediction markets contracts.

We are the industry leader by size with 15.9 million Average Monthly Players ("AMPs") and $16,383 million of revenue globally for fiscal 2025. AMPs refers to the average over the applicable reporting period of the total number of players who have had a bet settled and/or contributed to the rake (i.e., the commission we take for operating or hosting a game) or tournament fees during the month. This measure does not include individuals who have only used new player or player retention incentives, and this measure is for online players only and excludes retail player activity. See Part II, "Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations—Key Operational Metrics" for additional information regarding how we calculate AMPs data, including a discussion regarding duplication of players that exists in such data.

We operate a divisional management and operating structure across our geographic markets. Each division has an empowered management team responsible for maintaining the momentum and growth in its respective geographic markets. Effective from the first quarter of fiscal 2025, the Company updated its internal reporting, including the information provided to the chief operating decision maker to assess segment performance and allocate resources, and, as a result, updated its reportable segments for fiscal 2025.

headings: Risks Relating to Our Business and Industry
Economic downturns and market conditions beyond our control could adversely affect our business, financial condition and results of operations.

Our business is exposed to competitive pressures arising from competition in online betting and iGaming, as well as from prediction markets, illegal operators and new entrants into the markets in which we operate.
We may fail to retain existing customers or add new customers, or customers could decrease their level of engagement with our offerings in general.
Uncertainty as to the legality of online betting and/or iGaming or adverse public sentiment towards online betting and/or iGaming may deter third party suppliers from dealing with us.
Our success may be impacted by restrictions on our ongoing ability to market to our customers in certain jurisdictions.
We may prioritize customer growth and engagement and customer experience over short-term financial results.
Variability in win rates, the timing of jackpot payouts in our iGaming and the broadcasting and scheduling of major sporting events could materially adversely affect our financial results.
We are subject to risks related to our contractual and strategic relationships with third parties.
Geopolitical events and political developments could adversely affect our business, financial condition and results of operations.
Risks Relating to Information Technology Systems and Intellectual Property
We use AI, machine learning and similar technologies in our business, which may present business, compliance, and reputational risks.
paragraphs: You should carefully consider the following risks and all of the other information set forth in this Annual Report, including without limitation "Cautionary Statement Regarding Forward-looking Statements," Part II, "Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" and our consolidated financial statements and related notes in Part II, "Item 8. Financial Statements and Supplementary Data." The following risk factors have been organized by category for ease of use; however, many of the risks may have impacts in more than one category.

Our financial performance is subject to global economic conditions, and particularly, their impact on levels of spending by our customers, advertisers and partners. Unfavorable economic conditions, including recessions, economic slowdowns, tariffs and trade disputes, high unemployment, rising prices or the perception by consumers of weak or weakening economic conditions, may reduce levels of disposable income and participation in entertainment and leisure activities, such as betting or iGaming. Our business may be particularly sensitive to such changes, and as a result, there can be no assurance that demand for our product offerings will remain consistent.

A deterioration in global macroeconomic conditions could also adversely affect our business by increasing our overall cost structure and constraining our ability to invest in growth initiatives. For example, recent inflationary pressures have increased our labor costs and other operating expenses. Unfavorable economic conditions may also reduce the availability of credit, increase cost of credit or adversely affect our liquidity. If, as a result of such conditions, we are unable to secure financing when needed or on commercially acceptable terms, it may materially impair our ability to invest in new products, enhance our platforms or pursue strategic opportunities.

Adverse economic conditions that reduce customer participation or otherwise constrain liquidity may also materially reduce the attractiveness and competitiveness of our liquidity-dependent products such as Betfair Exchange, FanDuel's DFS and prediction markets and PokerStars' poker business, resulting in lower customer engagement and reduced revenues.

Additionally, the insolvency of any of our partners, advertisers or licensees could result in disrupted operations including by delaying payments owed to us, interrupting the delivery of services, or requiring us to identify and contract with replacement partners or require our exit from a particular market. Any of the foregoing could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition and results of operations.

We operate in a highly competitive and rapidly evolving global online betting and iGaming industry, and we expect competitive pressures to continue to intensify. Our competitors include international and well-established local betting and gaming operators as well as new entrants offering adjacent or alternative wagering products. Many of these competitors operate at significant scale enabling them to attract customers to their offerings, have strong brand recognition, and may spend more money and time on developing and testing products and services, undertake more extensive marketing campaigns, adopt more aggressive pricing or promotional policies or otherwise develop more commercially successful products or services than ours. In addition, new competitors, whether licensed or not, may enter the gaming industry, further increasing competitive pressure. Barriers to customers switching between operators are low, which increases the risk that customers may choose competing offerings.

Flutter is the world's leading online sports betting and iGaming operator based on revenue. Our ambition is to change our industry for the better and deliver long-term growth while also achieving a positive, sustainable future for all our stakeholders. We are well-placed to do so through the global competitive advantages of the Flutter Edge, which provides our brands with access to group-wide benefits to stay ahead of the competition, while maintaining a clear vision for sustainability through our Positive Impact Plan.

We are the industry leader by size with 15.9 million AMPs and $16,383 million of revenue globally for fiscal 2025. See "—Key Operational Metrics" below for additional information regarding how we calculate AMPs data, including a discussion regarding duplication of players that exists in such data.

Our strategy involves expanding our Group's player base and growing player value through product innovation and efficient player incentive spend, while also increasing the efficiency of our marketing investment and operating leverage to deliver high net income (loss) margins and Adjusted EBITDA Margins.
We believe that we are well-positioned to capitalize on the future long-term growth of the markets we operate in due to the following:

Diversified product and geographic portfolio at scale: We operate in a wide range of markets and offer a broad range of products. This level of diversification gives us exposure to fast-growing markets, and we also believe that it mitigates the impact on the overall Group of regulatory or other changes in individual markets. As a scale operator, we benefit from the "flywheel effect" where higher revenue growth enables greater operating leverage. This in turn enables us to invest more in our products and player proposition.

The Flutter Edge: We refer to our Group's global differentiator across product, technology, expertise and scale provided by empowering our local hero brands with the benefits of a global leader as the "Flutter Edge." It represents the symbiotic relationship between our teams and divisions, with all contributing to and benefitting from the Flutter Edge.

Win in the U.S. by (i) extending FanDuel Sportsbook's lead as the primary sportsbook in the U.S., (ii) cementing FanDuel Casino's position as the #1 casino brand and operator by gross gaming revenue and (iii) extend and deepen customer engagement through our Flywheel businesses, and (iv) transforming our earnings profile through operating leverage. We believe that we have a sustainable winning strategy driven by (i) the most efficient acquisition engine, (ii) a superior product proposition, (iii) a world class generosity proposition, and (iv) the best pricing in the market, enabled by our leading talent, technology and data platform and enhanced approach to government and public affairs. In addition, prediction markets are a significant incremental growth opportunity for FanDuel. We believe prediction markets will be TAM expansive; broadening reach by bringing sports markets to the approximately 40% of the U.S. population who cannot currently access online regulated sportsbooks, and by accessing a much broader range of "entertainment-first" customers. We are exceptionally well positioned to harness this opportunity given the nationwide strength of the FanDuel brand and our sports betting expertise, our deep understanding of this space gained through operating the Betfair Exchange, and our powerful strategic partnership with CME Group.

Win in rest of world by (i) consolidating our gold medal position in core markets, (ii) grow local hero brands through a combination of organic investment and M&A and (iii) enhance the earnings profile through diversification and cost efficiencies.
Opportunity for long-term growth through our financial growth engine
We believe that we are well-positioned to capitalize on the future long-term growth of the markets we operate in, through our financial growth engine. This is built on:

•Sustainable revenue growth: We seek to expand the Group's player base and grow player value through product innovation and efficient player incentive spend. We believe that there are significant revenue growth opportunities for both our U.S. and International businesses. Our U.S. business has grown revenue by 20%, from $5,798 million in fiscal 2024 to $6,967 million in fiscal 2025. FanDuel is also expanding into the newly emerging prediction markets space in the U.S. which we believe will provide an incremental opportunity for growth. Our International segment has grown revenue by 14%, from $8,250 million in fiscal 2024 to $9,416 million in fiscal 2025, and we believe that our International markets, which include UKI, Australia, Italy, Türkiye, Georgia, Armenia, Spain, Serbia, Morocco, and Brazil, provide the platform for continued high levels of future growth.

•Margin benefits: We seek to increase the efficiency of our marketing investment and operating leverage to deliver high net income (loss) margins and Adjusted EBITDA Margins. The Group's net income (loss) margins and Adjusted EBITDA Margins have been negatively impacted in recent years by significant investments in marketing and customer acquisition in the U.S. segment. As we deliver against our U.S. strategy, the net income (loss) margin and Adjusted EBITDA Margin of the U.S. segment have improved and we expect this trajectory to continue and drive further improvement in our consolidated net income (loss) margin and Adjusted EBITDA Margin over time.

•Significant cashflow generation: Although acquisitions have resulted in increased long-term debt in recent years, we believe that our disciplined capital allocation policy provides the flexibility to respond effectively to evolving market conditions and emerging opportunities. In 2026, we will prioritize significant capital deployment across both organic investment in our core business and strategic investment in the newly emerged prediction markets opportunity. Profit growth and cash generation is expected to continue to drive leverage reduction and unlock capital allocation opportunities for the Group. As of the end of fiscal 2025 and 2024, we had total long-term debt of $12,266 million and $6,736 million, respectively.

本公司之法定名稱為 Flutter Entertainment plc。本公司最初於1958年4月8日在愛爾蘭註冊為私人有限公司，名稱為 Corcoran's Management Limited，註冊編號為16956。本公司後於1988年透過合併三家獨立的賭場經營者，包括 Corcoran's Management Limited，成立為 Paddy Power plc。本公司於2000年11月15日重新註冊為公開有限公司，並於2000年12月在愛爾蘭證券交易所及倫敦證券交易所（"LSE"）上市。本公司於2016年2月2日與 Betfair Group plc 合併，並更名為 Paddy Power Betfair plc。本公司於2019年5月28日更名為 Flutter Entertainment plc。於2024年1月29日，本公司完成向美國證券交易委員會（"SEC"）的註冊程序，並在紐約證券交易所（"NYSE"）上市進行公開交易。自紐約證券交易所上市以來，本公司維持在倫敦證券交易所的上市地位，並已從愛爾蘭證券交易所除牌。於2024年5月31日，本公司根據2024年5月1日股東大會的批准，將主要上市地點轉至紐約證券交易所。

Flutter 是全球最大的線上運動賭博及 iGaming 操作商，以營業收入為衡量標準。我們的願景是改善我們的產業，並實現長期成長，同時為所有利害關係人創造正面且可持續的未來。我們透過 Flutter Edge 這項全球競爭優勢，使我們的品牌能取得集團內的優勢，以保持競爭優勢，同時透過 Positive Impact Plan 來維持對可持續性的清晰願景。
集團包含多樣化的領先休閒品牌與產品，擁有廣泛的國際影響力。我們經營一些世界上最獨特的線上運動賭博及 iGaming 品牌，提供我們主要產品類別：運動賭博、iGaming 及其他產品（場外投注、賽馬投注、每日運動賭博（"DFS"）及預測市場於美國）。

這些產品由 FanDuel（運動賭博、iGaming 及其他產品）、Sky Betting & Gaming（運動賭博及 iGaming 產品）、Sportsbet（運動賭博產品）、PokerStars（iGaming 產品）、Paddy Power（運動賭博及 iGaming 產品）、Sisal1（運動賭博及 iGaming 產品）、Snai（運動賭博、iGaming 產品及其他產品）、tombola（iGaming 產品）、Betfair（運動賭博、iGaming 及其他產品）、TVG（其他產品）、Adjarabet（iGaming 產品）、MaxBet（運動賭博及 iGaming 產品）及 Betnacional（運動賭博及 iGaming 產品）提供。
於財務年度2025，我們已完成以下收購：
1 Sisal 的 iGaming 產品包含零售及線上彩券產品。有關更多資訊，請參閱 "—我們的產品—iGaming" 下方之內容。
•持有 Boyd Interactive Holdings L.L.C. ("Boyd") 所持有的 FanDuel Group Parent LLC ("FanDuel") 5% 可贖回非控制性權益，交易金額為 1,553 億美元。此項收購使本集團對 FanDuel 的持股比例達 100%（視 Fox Option 而定）。

2025 年 12 月，我們與 CME Group ("CME") 合作，在五個州推出 FanDuel Predicts，開始分階段的全國擴張，至 2026 年初為止，並為符合資格的客戶提供手機及網頁平台，用以交易預測市場合約。

我們在規模上為產業領先，2025 財年全球平均每月玩家數（"AMPs"）為 1,590 萬人，營業收入為 16,383 億美元。AMPs 指的是在適用的報告期間內，總玩家數的平均數，這些玩家曾下過投注並/或貢獻至 rake（即我們為運營或主辦賽事所收取的佣金）或賽事費用。此指標不包括僅使用新玩家或玩家留存激勵措施的個體，且此指標僅針對線上玩家，不包含零售玩家活動。有關我們如何計算 AMPs 數據的更多資訊，請參閱第二部分，"第 7 項 管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之分析—關鍵營運指標"，包括有關此數據中玩家重複計算的討論。

Flutter 為全球營業收入最高的線上運動賭博及 iGaming 操作商。我們的願景是改善我們的產業，並實現長期成長，同時為所有利害關係人創造正面且可持續的未來。我們透過 Flutter Edge 這項全球競爭優勢，處於極佳的條件來達成此目標，此優勢使我們的品牌能獲得集團內的效益，以保持對競爭對手的優勢，同時透過我們的 Positive Impact Plan 來維持對可持續性的清晰願景。
我們以規模為產業領先，於財務 2025 年全球擁有 15.9 億 AMPs 及 163.83 億美元營業收入。請參閱下方「—關鍵營運指標」以取得更多關於我們如何計算 AMPs 數據的資訊，包括有關此數據中玩家重複計算之討論。
我們的策略為透過產品創新與高效能玩家激勵支出，擴大集團玩家基礎並提升玩家價值，同時提高市場投資與營運槓桿效率，以實現高淨收入（損失）邊際與調整後 EBITDA 邊際。
我們相信我們處於極佳的條件，以把握我們所經營市場未來的長期成長機會，原因如下：
規模化的多樣化產品與地理組合：我們在廣泛的市場中運作，並提供多樣化的產品。這種程度的多樣化使我們能接觸快速成長的市場，我們也認為這能降低個別市場的法規或其他變動對整個集團的影響。作為一家規模操作商，我們能受益於「飛輪效應」，即更高的營收成長能帶來更大的營運槓桿。這使我們能投入更多資源在產品與玩家方案上。
Flutter Edge：我們稱我們集團在產品、科技、專業知識與規模方面的全球差異化優勢為「Flutter Edge」，此優勢透過賦能我們的本地英雄品牌，使其能享有全球領導者的效益。這代表我們團隊與部門之間的共生關係，所有團隊與部門皆貢獻並受益於 Flutter Edge。

透過 (i) 延伸 FanDuel Sportsbook 為美國主要體育賭博平台的領導地位，(ii) 鞏固 FanDigital Casino 為以營收計為 #1 個賭博品牌與操作商的定位，(iii) 延伸並深化透過 Flywheel 事業的客戶參與，以及 (iv) 透過營運槓桿轉變我們的獲利模式，我們相信我們擁有可持續的獲勝策略。我們認為此策略由 (i) 最高效的獲客引擎，(ii) 優越的產品方案，(iii) 世界級的慷慨方案，以及 (iv) 市場最佳的價格，所驅動，此為我們領先的人才、科技與數據平台，以及對政府與公共事務的增強方法所促成。此外，預測市場為 FanDuel 的重要成長機會。我們相信預測市場將有廣大的市場規模；透過將體育市場帶給目前約 40% 美國人口無法接觸線上受規範體育賭博平台的羣體，並透過接觸更廣泛的「娛樂為先」客戶。我們極為具備條件來把握此機會，這歸功於 FanDuel 品牌在全國的強大聲譽與我們的體育賭博專業知識，我們透過經營 Betfair Exchange 所獲得的對此領域的深入理解，以及我們與 CME Group 的強大戰略合作夥伴關係。
在其他地區取得勝利，透過 (i) 統合我們在核心市場的金牌地位、(ii) 透過有機投資與併購來拓展本地英雄品牌，以及 (iii) 透過多元化與成本效益來提升獲利能力。
透過我們的財務成長引擎，獲得長遠成長的機會
我們認為，我們已處於有利位置，能透過我們的財務成長引擎，把握我們所經營市場的未來長遠成長機會。此財務成長引擎建立於：

• 可持續的營收成長：我們致力於擴大集團的玩家基礎，並透過產品創新與高效的玩家激勵支出來提升玩家價值。我們認為，我們的美國與國際業務均有顯著的營收成長機會。美國業務在財務 2024 年營收為 57.98 億美元，至財務 2025 年成長為 69.67 億美元。FanDuel 也在美國新興的預測市場領域擴張，我們認為這將提供進一步的成長機會。國際業務在財務 2024 年營收為 82.5 億美元，至財務 2025 年成長為 94.16 億美元，我們認為我們的國際市場，包括 UKI、澳洲、義大利、土耳其、格魯吉亞、亞美尼亞、西班牙、塞爾維亞、摩洛哥與巴西，提供了持續高水準未來成長的平台。

• 利潤率優勢：我們致力於提高行銷投資與營運槓桿的效率，以實現高淨收入（損失）毛利率與調整後 EBITDA 毛利率。集團的淨收入（損失）毛利率與調整後 EBITDA 毛利率在近年因美國業務的重大行銷與用戶取得投資而受到負面影響。隨著我們落實美國策略，美國業務的淨收入（損失）毛利率與調整後 EBITDA 毛利率已改善，我們預期此趨勢會持續，並在未來進一步提升我們的合併淨收入（損失）毛利率與調整後 EBITDA 毛利率。

• 顯著的現金流產生：儘管併購導致近年長期債務增加，我們認為我們的嚴謹資本配置政策提供了靈活性，以有效應對市場條件的變化與新興機會。在 2026 年，我們將優先進行大量資本部署，包括對核心業務的有機投資與對新興預測市場機會的戰略投資。獲利成長與現金流產生預期會持續推動負債降低，並為集團創造資本配置的機會。截至財務 2025 年與財務 2024 年年底，我們的總長期債務分別為 122.66 億美元與 67.36 億美元。

headings: 與我們業務及產業相關的風險
經濟衰退及我們無法控制的市場情況可能對我們的業務、財務狀況及營運成果產生不利影響。
我們的業務面臨來自線上賭博及iGaming產業的競爭壓力，以及來自預測市場、非法經營者及新進市場參與者的競爭。
我們可能無法維持現有客戶或增加新客戶，或客戶可能降低對我們產品的參與度。
對於線上賭博及/或iGaming合法性的不確定性，或對線上賭博及/或iGaming的負面公眾觀感，可能使第三方供應商避免與我們合作。
我們的業務成果可能受到我們在某些司法管轄區持續行銷能力的限制影響。
我們可能優先考量客戶成長與參與度及客戶體驗，而非短期財務成果。
獲勝率的變動、iGaming中頭獎發放時間及重大體育賽事的轉播與賽程安排，可能對我們的財務結果產生重大不利影響。
本公司面臨與第三方之契約及戰略關係相關之風險。
地緣政治事件及政治發展可能對本公司之業務、財務狀況及營運成果產生不利影響。
資訊科技系統及智慧財產權相關風險
本公司於業務中運用人工智能、機器學習及類似技術，此等技術可能帶來業務、合規及聲譽風險。
paragraphs: 您應仔細審閱下列風險，以及本年度報告中所載的其他資訊，包括但不限於「關於前瞻性陳述的警示聲明」，第二部分「項目 7. 管理層對財務狀況與營運結果之分析」，以及我們合併財務報表及相關附註，第二部分「項目 8. 財務報表與補充資料」。下列風險因素已按類別整理，以便使用；然而，許多風險可能對多個類別產生影響。
我們的財務表現受全球經濟條件影響，特別是對我們客戶、廣告客戶及合作夥伴支出水準的影響。不利的經濟條件，包括經濟衰退、經濟放緩、關稅與貿易爭議、高失業率、物價上漲或消費者對經濟條件疲弱或惡化的看法，可能會降低可支配所得與參與娛樂與休閒活動的水準，例如賭博或 iGaming。我們的業務可能對這些變動特別敏感，因此無法保證對我們產品的 demand 將持續一致。
全球總體經濟條件惡化也可能透過增加我們整體成本結構與限制我們投資成長計畫的能力，對我們的業務產生不利影響。例如，近期的通貨膨脹壓力已提高我們的勞動成本及其他營運費用。不利的經濟條件也可能降低信貸的可取得性、提高信貸成本或對我們的流動性產生不利影響。如果因這些條件，我們無法在需要時取得融資或在商業上可接受的條件下取得融資，可能會嚴重影響我們投資新產品、提升平台或追求戰略機會的能力。
不利的經濟條件若降低客戶參與度或以其他方式限制流動性，也可能嚴重降低我們依賴流動性的產品如 Betfair Exchange、FanDuel 的 DFS 與預測市場以及 PokerStars 的賭博業務的吸引力與競爭力，導致客戶參與度降低與收入減少。
此外，任何我們合作夥伴、廣告客戶或授權方的財務困難，可能會導致運營中斷，包括延遲應付我們的付款、中斷服務的交付，或要求我們識別並與替代合作夥伴簽訂合約，或要求我們退出特定市場。上述任何情況都可能對我們的業務、財務狀況與營運結果產生重大不利影響。

我們經營於一個高度競爭且快速演變的全球在線賭博與 iGaming 行業，我們預期競爭壓力將持續加劇。我們的競爭對手包括國際性與本地已建立的賭博與遊戲運營商，以及提供相關或替代賭博產品的新進企業。許多這些競爭對手規模龐大，使其能夠吸引客戶至其產品，擁有強大的品牌認知度，並可能投入更多資金與時間於產品與服務的開發與測試，進行更廣泛的市場推廣活動，採用更激進的價格或促銷政策，或以其他方式開發更商業成功的產品或服務。此外，無論是否取得許可，新的競爭對手可能進入遊戲產業，進一步增加競爭壓力。客戶在不同運營商之間轉換的門檻較低，這增加了客戶可能選擇競爭產品的風險。
